title: Compute the total amount of all transactions made in 1998 by the account th
question: Compute the total amount of all transactions made in 1998 by the account that received the largest loan ever approved, ensuring the loan was issued before 1998 and the account was opened prior to 1997.

prediction.sql:
SELECT SUM(t."XCL_051")
FROM trans AS t
INNER JOIN account AS a ON t."XCL_047" = a."XCL_001"
WHERE a."XCL_001" = (
    SELECT a2."XCL_001"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN loan AS l2 ON a2."XCL_001" = l2."XCL_034"
    WHERE l2."XCL_035" < '1998-01-01'
      AND a2."XCL_004" < '1997-01-01'
    ORDER BY l2."XCL_036" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1998';
